source: the figures' parameters: δ is the evasion threshold (a bound holds unless the adversary evades detection with probability above δ), the budgets are the curves' shares of the scope's GPU-seconds spent on replays, interior commitments and proofs, the overheads span the x-axis, and serving commits a token id as a u32; main_lines names, by label prefix and per panel, the reference lines the main figure plots and their line style (the appendix plots the rest), and notes the sentences each caption ends with

exfiltration: The advice line (dashed) is a registered cap of 6 bits a request, the most accepted advice is charged, with the KV pool in the circuit, under which every traced window fits; the pool is designed, not built at session scale. Certified ticks make the advice 0 bits, so they have no line, and the tick rule isn't built either. The charges are vLLM's scheduler serving Llama 3 models, not measured on the served model.
